status: Owner supports long horizontal layout; Natural cap-style correction pending visual review. Color-radio behavior unchanged.
supersedes: owner-spec.md decorative-only pen behavior, plus the first comps' toolbar marker swatches and digital-panel card treatment
role: one radio group named マーカーの色

interaction.tap: Select the pen's marker color, not the desk theme or a handwriting engine.
interaction.keyboard: Use native radio behavior with visible focus and arrow-key selection.
interaction.selection: Exactly one selected. Persist the actual selected color and restore it after reload.
interaction.state: Keep draft text, focused input selection, completed sentences, current practice step, checks, memo choices and ink playback position.
interaction.markersOff: Selecting a color updates the stored preference without silently turning markers on. Reflect it when markers are enabled again.
interaction.themeChange: Retain selected marker color when changing desk theme; replace pen appearance only.
interaction.fontAndLineWidth: Selecting any theme pen or marker changes marker color only, never the shared handwriting glyphs or stroke width.

required: color-matched barrel, cap or visible band
colorIdentification.walnut: Keep black/brass fountain-pen bodies; use a clearly colored cap/finial band plus a visible color name.
colorIdentification.referencePhotos: Use shape/material language, not the brands/logos or the reference photo's original limited palette.

selectedAppearance.description: Selected pen may shift8px left along its long axis; label gains a small check. No enlarged silhouette, glow or enclosing card.

targetSizing.hitRegion: Whole pen plus color label with non-overlapping clear targets.
targetSizing.visualSilhouette: Use isolated pen images over native semantic radios; transparent image gaps must not block other UI.

card.outerBox: Shared across themes and modes; fixed above note, clear of metadata/title.
card.corners: Near-square physical cardstock, no glossy round app-panel border.
card.material: Subtle matte uncoated paper, visible thin paper edge and soft cast shadow; minimal theme-appropriate ruling.
card.controls: Readonly source audio/meaning actions only. Confirmation belongs next to notebook, never on card.
card.print: Pen controls/card/material UI never enter the note PDF.

illustrationScope: Static appearance and contracts only. Native notebook typing/IME/pen radios/persistence remain implementation work.

latestPenFamilies.natural: simple slim matte capped felt-tip/study markers with molded same-color clips; no click/ballpoint hardware
latestPenFamilies.walnut: retained black/brass with colored cap bands

layout.labels: persistent at right of each pen
layout.hitRegion: one full row per radio; no overlap
